qualifier: OTC deficiency variants
name: Urea cycle citrulline-arginine synthesis and OTC deficiency
rationale: All members concern urea-cycle synthesis of citrulline and arginine; the OTC deficiency variants separate it from neighbouring urea-cycle themes and from the theme of other urea-cycle enzyme disorders that lacks the cycle itself.

core: Vitamin K, C and E metabolism and response
qualifier: vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate/vitamin E metabolism
rationale: Members are vitamin K, vitamin C and vitamin E metabolism/response terms; gamma-carboxylation plus ascorbate handling distinguishes it from the vitamin D, vitamin E/ubiquinol and oxygen-transport confusables.

qualifier: proline / glutamine family
name: Proline-centred glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are proline synthesis and catabolism plus general L-amino-acid and glutamine-family metabolism terms; proline/glutamine-family focus separates it from glycine/serine/glyoxylate and organic-acid confusables.

qualifier: RHOA/B/C and CDC42 with formin activation
name: RHOA/B/C and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: All members are Rho-family GTPase cycles or their signalling; RHOA/B/C, CDC42 via G beta:gamma and formin activation distinguish it from confusables built on RAC, RND, RHOU/V, PAK/ROCK and IQGAP.

qualifier: Gram-positive bacteria and fungi; neutrophil cytotoxicity
name: Antimicrobial killing of Gram-positive bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members describe host killing and cytolysis of microbes, including antifungal, yeast and Gram-positive defence and metal sequestration; neutrophil cytotoxicity regulation and antifungal/Gram-positive scope separate it from respiratory-burst, degranulation and iron-assimilation confusables.

qualifier: COPI retrograde transport and Rab/ARF regulation
name: Rab/ARF-regulated COPI Golgi traffic and Golgi organization
rationale: Members cover Golgi structure, COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic, and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation (GEFs, GAPs, geranylgeranylation); this distinguishes it from TGN/endolysosomal sorting and COPII export confusables.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport and osmotic stress response
name: Osmotic stress response and cation-chloride cotransport
rationale: Members concern Na+, K+, Cl- and water balance in epithelia and cells, including salt-wasting cotransporter diseases; the osmotic/hyperosmotic stress responses and chloride transport separate it from aldosterone, NHE, K2P-channel and magnesium/tight-junction confusables.

core: MECP2 regulation of neuronal gene expression
qualifier: NCoR/HDAC corepressor repression
name: MECP2 neuronal gene repression via NCoR/HDAC corepressors
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation, its Rett-type loss-of-function variants, its neuronal target programmes and associated sensory behaviours; the NCoR/SMRT binding and HDAC histone deacetylation members distinguish it from the closest MECP2 confusable and from behaviour/glycinergic confusables.

qualifier: NAD(P) salvage, nucleotide phosphorylation and phosphocreatine
name: NAD(P) salvage, nucleotide phosphorylation and phosphocreatine energy buffering
rationale: Members maintain cellular energy cofactors: NAD(P) synthesis/salvage, nucleoside di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and creatine phosphate buffering; each confusable lacks one of these three arms.

qualifier: erythroid commitment and terminal red cell maturation
name: Erythroid commitment and terminal red cell differentiation
rationale: Members are erythrocyte differentiation terms and erythroid gene modules (TAL1-GFI1B commitment, terminal membrane/enucleation), with one stress-signalling module; erythroid focus separates it from megakaryocyte/platelet and HSC/primitive-definitive haematopoiesis confusables.

qualifier: termination and R-loop processing
name: RNA polymerase II transcription control including termination and R-loops
rationale: Members regulate Pol II initiation, elongation and termination plus transcription-coupled gene-expression modules; termination, R-loop processing and chromatin-binding restraint distinguish it from elongation/pausing and rRNA/RNA-processing confusables.

qualifier: BCR signalling and its inhibitory tuning
name: B cell activation via BCR signaling and inhibitory tuning
rationale: Members describe B cell development, proliferation and activation; BCR signalling with CD22/BTK/RAS and positive/negative BCR regulation separate it from confusables built on B cell surface signatures, plasma/memory cells and T follicular help.

qualifier: suppression of NHEJ and recombination
name: Telomere end protection against NHEJ and recombination
rationale: All members concern capping and protecting telomere ends, including blocking NHEJ and recombination and limiting telomerase; protection rather than telomere replication, D-loop handling or telomerase extension separates it from confusables.

qualifier: 3'UTR-binding proteins and stress granules
name: 3'UTR-mediated mRNA stability and translation control in stress granules
rationale: Members cover RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability (HuR, AUF1, IGF2BP, CRD) and translation, plus stress-granule dynamics and PKR/arsenite stress; stabilisers and stress granules distinguish it from TTP/BRF1/KSRP decay and decapping confusables.

qualifier: AXIN stability and destruction complex
name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN stability and destruction complex
rationale: All members are canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling steps; AXIN degradation/XAV939 stabilisation and destruction-complex mutants distinguish it from confusables centred on DVL, FZD and repression of target genes.

qualifier: KATP channels and incretin/fatty-acid stimulation
name: Beta-cell insulin secretion via KATP channels and incretins
rationale: Members cover islet insulin secretion, its KATP-channel, glucokinase, incretin and fatty-acid receptor regulation, and insulin processing/turnover; secretion-side biology separates it from insulin-receptor signalling and GLUT4 translocation confusables.

core: Vascular endothelial and smooth muscle cell regulation
qualifier: VEGF/Tie2 angiogenesis plus smooth muscle phenotypic switching
name: VEGF/Tie2 angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
rationale: Members regulate blood-vessel growth: VEGF/VEGFR and Tie2 angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; the smooth muscle arm separates it from the closest angiogenesis confusable and the VEGF/Tie2 arm from leukocyte-adhesion confusables.

qualifier: convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern planar cell polarity and the convergent-extension tissue movements it drives; convergent extension in axis elongation/organogenesis and neural plate morphogenesis distinguish it from mesoderm, ciliary and midline-patterning confusables.

qualifier: TCR and BCR with costimulation and co-inhibition
name: TCR and BCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members are proximal TCR and BCR signalling and their CD28 costimulatory and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibitory control; including BCR signalling separates it from T-cell-only confusables, and PECAM1/antigen-presentation members from the closest BCR confusable.

qualifier: neutral amino acid transporters and Hartnup/dicarboxylic aminoaciduria
name: Plasma membrane neutral amino acid transport and aminoacidurias
rationale: Members are amino acid transport across the plasma membrane and SLC transporter diseases; Hartnup (SLC6A19), SLC6A14 and SLC1A1 members distinguish it from iminoglycinuria, cystinuria and oligopeptide-transport confusables.

qualifier: SERCA reuptake and Na+/Ca2+ exchange clearance
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and Na+/Ca2+ exchange clearance
rationale: Members regulate Ca2+ release (ryanodine, caffeine) and reuptake into the SR/ER and cytosolic Ca2+ removal; SERCA regulation and Na+/Ca2+ exchange separate it from cardiac-contraction and calcium-release-only confusables.

qualifier: base excision repair and direct alkylation reversal
name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair (glycosylase defects, AP-site processing, short/long patch) and direct reversal of alkylation (MGMT, ALKBH2/3); the reversal arm separates it from mismatch-repair confusables and long-patch BER from ICL/demethylation confusables.

qualifier: cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3
name: TGF-beta/BMP/activin SMAD signaling with cancer mutants and RUNX3
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signalling and its regulation (TGFBR3, follistatin); cancer-associated TGFBR/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets distinguish it from extracellular ligand-sequestration, YAP/FOXO and morphogen-module confusables.

qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial sensing and NLRP inflammasomes
name: TLR2/4 bacterial sensing and NLRP inflammasome cytokine regulation
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/4/5 sensing of bacterial ligands (LPS, lipopeptide, LTA, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency) and NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 production; this pairing separates it from pyroptosis/AIM2, TRIF/IL-10 and monocyte-signature confusables.

qualifier: telomerase Cajal body trafficking
name: Telomere maintenance including telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members span telomere capping, replication, recombination-based maintenance and telomerase extension; telomerase RNA/scaRNA localisation to Cajal bodies distinguishes it from the closest DNA-repair-heavy confusables.

qualifier: snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
name: Non-coding RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are methylation and other modification of rRNA, tRNA and snRNA plus snoRNP and snRNP assembly and trafficking; cap hypermethylation, snRNA transport and snRNP assembly distinguish it from pseudouridylation, diphthamide/wybutosine and Cajal-body confusables.

qualifier: soluble-agonist GPCR signalling, aggregation and degranulation
name: Platelet agonist GPCR signaling, aggregation and degranulation
rationale: Members concern platelet activation and haemostasis; ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signalling separate it from collagen/GPIb adhesion confusables, and aggregation, degranulation and coagulation from integrin/Rap1 confusables.

qualifier: PUMA/NOXA and cytochrome c release
name: p53-driven apoptosis via PUMA/NOXA and cytochrome c release
rationale: Members are TP53 transcription of death genes and BH3-only PUMA/NOXA activation leading to cytochrome c release; combining p53 transcription with BH3-only action distinguishes it from BAX/BAK-only and p53-regulation-only confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar layer formation and motor learning
name: Cerebellar development underlying motor coordination and learning
rationale: Members are motor behaviours (locomotion, righting, proprioception, motor learning) and cerebellar/striatal development, plus a neuronal RNA-binding module; cerebellar layer formation and motor learning separate it from vocal, sensory and glycinergic behaviour confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: RAF-MEK-ERK signaling, oncogenic mutants and ERK dephosphorylation feedback
rationale: All members are RAF/MAP2K/ERK cascade activation, its disease mutants, or its negative feedback by ERK dephosphorylation; mutant RAF signalling and ERK inactivation distinguish it from SOS/RIT and RAS-GAP confusables.
